description: Claims filed against housing insurance policies. One row per claim.

columns.name: claim_id
columns.description: Unique identifier of the claim (format CLM#####). Primary key.

columns.name: policy_id
columns.description: Policy the claim was filed under. Foreign key to policy_coverage.policy_id.

columns.name: claim_type
columns.description: Cause of loss (peril): Water Damage, Fire, Theft, Wind/Hail, Liability, Vandalism, Flood, Mold.

columns.name: incident_date
columns.description: Date the loss occurred (YYYY-MM-DD). Should fall between the policy's start_date and end_date.

columns.name: reported_date
columns.description: Date the claim was reported to the insurer (YYYY-MM-DD). Should be on or after incident_date.

columns.name: claim_amount
columns.description: Amount in USD requested by the owner for the loss.

columns.name: approved_amount
columns.description: Amount in USD approved for payment after adjustment and deductible. 0 when the claim is Denied or Under Review.

columns.name: claim_status
columns.description: Claim workflow state: Under Review (being assessed), Approved (accepted, payment pending), Paid (payment issued), Denied (rejected), Closed (finalised).

columns.name: adjuster_name
columns.description: Claims adjuster assigned to assess the claim.

columns.name: closed_date
columns.description: Date the claim was settled or closed (YYYY-MM-DD). Empty while the claim is Under Review or Approved.
